summary: Iteration 24 verified the Compass engine revision — (1) Instructional Networks (related_elements injection) and (2) Developmental Memory (session.developmental_profile) — end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest checks passed on a real 2-turn social-media session. Turn 1 seeded a non-empty developmental_profile (Central Claim: confused/emerging, episodes=1). Turn 2 (revise draft that took a clear position) MERGED the same element in place (Central Claim: emerging, episodes=2) and appended a second observation (Evidence: confused) — no duplicates. theory.instructional_reasoning.evidence_of_developmental_movement was populated with a substantive statement ('draft shifted from hedge to contestable claim with reasons — clear developmental movement'), not the sentinel 'initial'. Profile persists on GET /sessions/{id} (not recomputed). One instructional target per turn (scaffolding_control.primary_target singular string; instructional_reasoning.active_instructional_element singular string). intervention.focus == 'writing' on both turns. Governed instruction intact: POST /interact returns immediately (<15s) with an ai turn of status='processing', polling reaches 'complete' (~65-75s single turn). The invitation names network neighbors (position/purpose/reader/evidence/reasons) rather than treating the target in isolation, and does NOT co-author the student's thesis. No 5xx errors from network injection. Frontend: on the public preview URL, loaded a completed 2-turn TEST_iter24 session via localStorage.dws_session_id; ?dev auto-quickstart bypass respected. Student Workspace unchanged and functional (writing-area, continue-button, assignment-prompt persistently visible showing the full TEST prompt, reset-to-sample-button, new-assignment-button). Dev Panel opens; the NEW 'developmental-memory-block' accordion is present and open by default; renders 2 items (dev-memory-item-0 = 'Central Claim · emerging · 2', dev-memory-item-1 = 'Evidence · confused') each showing element + trend badge + episode count + control_statement + evidence-basis. Existing instructional-reasoning-block, scaffolding-control-block, integration-calibration-block all still render. toggle-research-view still flips Teacher view <-> Research view. No JS errors in console.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L127-148 build_instructional_network() correctly (a) computes target names first, (b) walks each target's related_elements in insertion order, (c) skips names that are already targets OR already added neighbors (dedupe), (d) looks up neighbors via alias-aware _IO_BY_NAME with .lower() so aliases resolve, (e) returns compact {element, communicative_purpose, relates_to_targets} — the last field is what lets the LLM reason WITH the network rather than as isolated leaves. Verified against the injected prompt block at L810.

server.py L312-320 DevelopmentalObservation model uses `episodes: int = 1` and default `updated_at` from now_iso — new observations always start at 1, and the merge path at L872 increments in place. Correct semantics for 'not chat memory, developmental memory'.

server.py L856-882 _merge_developmental_profile() correctly (a) builds a lowercased element index up front, (b) updates control_statement/trend/evidence ONLY when the LLM supplies a non-empty value ('u.get(x) or existing.x') — no null-clobbering, (c) bumps episodes on merge, (d) refreshes updated_at, (e) appends new observations and re-registers them in by_el so a same-turn dup is also caught. This exactly satisfies the 'match element -> update + episodes++, else append' contract from the review request.

server.py L694-701 _developmental_profile_summary() provides an explicit 'no prior developmental evidence' seed message for turn 1 — the prompt is well-formed even when the profile is empty. Prevents empty-string / broken-format edge cases.
server.py L1090 the /$set update INCLUDES developmental_profile — confirms the profile is persisted (not recomputed from turns each request). GET /sessions returns it directly via the Session model.

server.py L1058-1093 _run_reasoning() re-reads the session AFTER reasoning (doc2) and merges onto the freshly-loaded session2 — this preserves concurrent writes and is the correct pattern for durable processing. The developmental_profile persistence path is safe against overlapping turns (though the 409 guard at L1114 already prevents concurrent turns).
DevelopmentPanel.jsx L378-393 computeDefaults() correctly includes `developmental_memory: true` so the new accordion is OPEN by default — matches the review-request statement 'open by default'.
DevelopmentPanel.jsx L643-673 renders the profile list with per-item data-testid `dev-memory-item-${i}` — testable and stable indexing.

MINOR: DevelopmentPanel.jsx L654 uses `key={i}` for the profile list; if the LLM ever reorders observations across turns this could cause stale DOM. Since _merge_developmental_profile keeps ordering stable (updates in place; appends at the end), this is safe today. If the merge policy ever changes to reorder, keying by o.element would be safer.
MINOR (carry-over from iter23): LLM sometimes emits internal M-numbers into integration_calibration.supporting_frameworks. Not in scope for iter24.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_24 verified the Compass engine revision (instructional networks + developmental memory) end-to-end. Backend test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_developmental_memory_iteration24.py — it drives a 2-turn social-media session and asserts (a) profile is seeded on turn 1, (b) profile is MERGED (not duplicated) with episodes bumped or trend advanced on turn 2, (c) evidence_of_developmental_movement populated with substantive content, (d) profile persists via GET, (e) exactly one primary_target per turn, (f) invitation integrates with network neighbors and does not co-author. Runtime is ~135s (2 sequential LLM turns ~65s each). If POST /sessions payload shape ever changes, the fixture at L38 needs updating. Frontend flow: to test the Dev Panel WITHOUT paying the LLM cost, query mongo for a completed TEST_iter24 session id, drop it into localStorage['dws_session_id'], remove sessionStorage['dws_manual_setup'], then load ?dev — the app will restore that session and the Dev Panel will render developmental-memory-block with dev-memory-item-N children. Reasoning is LLM-bound and slow — never treat multi-turn latency as a failure.
rca of the issue: No defects in the shipped iteration_24 revision. My first test payload used the wrong POST /sessions shape (assignment_context envelope + kind='draft'); corrected to SessionCreate fields (assignment/pedagogical_purpose/current_writing_task/assignment_prompt) and InteractRequest kinds ('writing' first, 'revise' second) per DRAFT_KINDS set in server.py. After that fix all 10 backend tests passed on the first real run. Frontend verification observed the exact backend state in the DOM (Central Claim emerging·2 + Evidence confused), confirming the full backend->frontend integration.
